settings.languageDescription: Choose the language used for Local AI Runtime controls and guidance.

settings.manualSetupPrivacy: This writes a local engine configuration. No model file is uploaded.
settings.backendHint: GPU placement is not guaranteed. Verify it with a real local request.
settings.privacyDescription: Models, configuration and logs stay in your local user-data folder. Local AI Runtime does not upload prompts, responses or hardware inventory.
device.title: Device & model fit
device.privacy: Hardware details are detected on this computer only. Detection is a starting point, not a compatibility guarantee.
device.measureGpu: Measure GPU during a local test
device.gpuHint: Start a CUDA-enabled chat engine before measuring GPU activity during a real local request.
chat.historyPrivacy: Conversations are stored only in this browser on this device.

chat.invalidStream: The model returned an invalid streaming response.

chat.emptyResponse: The model returned an empty response.
chat.stoppedBeforeResponse: Generation stopped before a response arrived.

chat.promptExplain: Explain a complex idea in simple terms.
chat.promptPlan: Help me plan a small project step by step.
chat.promptWrite: Review this text and suggest improvements.
chat.streamIncomplete: The model stream ended before completion. Any partial response has been kept.
activity.resourcesDescription: Live CPU and memory readings are local. Engine usage is process-level; NVIDIA GPU readings are system-wide and may include other apps.
activity.resourcesGpuUnavailable: Live GPU telemetry is unavailable on this device.
activity.resourcesGpuScope: GPU readings are system-wide and do not prove that a particular engine uses the GPU.

onboarding.allComplete: Your local chat setup is complete. You can hide this guide or reopen it from Settings.
onboarding.deviceDescription: Read local CPU, memory and graphics information before choosing a model.
onboarding.modelDescription: Browse reviewed components, check the license and install a model for local chat.

onboarding.chatDescription: Chat with the model. Prompts and responses stay in this browser on this device.

updates.upToDateCopy: This installation is running {version}. No newer version is available in the selected release channel. Your local models and settings are unchanged.
updates.desktopCopy: The complete desktop update ({version}) is available. The desktop shell will verify the official Windows setup installer against GitHub’s SHA-256 digest, create a full application backup, update the shell and runtime together, and check local health before keeping the update. Settings, engines, models and logs remain in your user-data folder.
updates.desktopMissing: A newer release ({version}) is available, but its Windows desktop installer is not attached yet. The current installation will not be changed.
updates.applyDesktop: After verification, choose Apply update & restart. The previous files are kept for rollback.
updates.applyWindowsArchive: This installation cannot safely replace itself in place. Use the release download to extract the verified package into a new application folder, then start it there. Your settings, engines and models remain in the separate user-data folder.
updates.applyManualArchive: This platform verifies the official package in the app but does not yet install it in place. Close the app, extract the new archive into a new folder, and start it again; settings, engines and models remain in your user-data folder.
updates.unsupportedPackage: You are using {current}. A newer release exists, but the official release metadata does not include a supported package and SHA-256 digest for this computer. Open the release notes to download manually; automatic staging is disabled.
updates.unavailableBackground: Could not check for updates · local app remains available
updates.failedCopy: Local AI Runtime is still available. Check your internet connection or open GitHub Releases to check the current version manually.
updates.checkFailed: Update check failed · local app remains available
updates.staged: Verified package {version} is staged ({size}). Its size and SHA-256 were checked again on this device. Your running application, settings, engines and models have not been changed.
updates.awaitingHealth: Application files were replaced and the new runtime is being checked. If the update helper stops unexpectedly, the launcher will restore the verified backup before starting the app.
updates.applyingCopy: The update helper is applying the verified package. The runtime will restart; keep this folder and the user-data folder in place. If the operation is interrupted, the launcher will attempt verified backup recovery.
updates.rollbackFailed: Automatic rollback failed. Check the local update log before attempting another update.
updates.applyUnsupported: Apply-and-restart is not supported by this installation. The verified package is kept staged and no files were changed.
updates.desktopShellHint: The secure in-app installer is available in the Windows desktop shell. Use the Local AI Runtime notification-area icon and choose “Check for updates”.
updates.requestPackage: Requesting the official platform package. No running files will be changed.
updates.verifiedReadyCopy: The {version} package was downloaded and its SHA-256 digest matched GitHub release metadata. It is staged in the Local AI Runtime user-data folder. Nothing has been changed.
updates.downloadFailedCopy: {detail} Your current installation and user data are unchanged.
updates.applyStarting: The update helper is verifying the staged package once more, preparing a backup, and will restart the runtime. The dashboard may briefly disconnect.
updates.applyAccepted: Update accepted. Waiting for the runtime to stop and return. The page will reload when the apply result is available.
updates.applyCouldNotCopy: {detail} The verified package remains staged; no update is reported as successful unless the restarted runtime passes its health check.
updates.takingLong: Update status for {version} is taking longer than expected
updates.takingLongCopy: The runtime has not returned to a verifiable state yet. Do not delete the rollback folder. Inspect %LOCALAPPDATA%/LocalAIRuntime/logs/update-apply.log and apply-status.json before retrying.
models.evidence: Evidence: package {package}; real task {task}; hardware profile {profile}.
models.compatibilityDisclaimer: Compatibility and resource estimates are metadata, not a guarantee that this component will work on every machine.
models.acceptLicense: I have reviewed and accept this component’s license.
models.confirmDownload: Download and install “{name}”? {sizeHint} Only files verified against the published SHA-256 will be activated.
models.resolveSize: The exact archive size will be resolved from official release metadata.
models.licenseCheck: Before downloading, tick the clearly marked “Required before install” license box on that component card.
models.queued: Queued {name} as {job}. Follow the installation status below.
models.installBlocked: Installation is disabled because no safe HTTPS license link is available.
models.noFilterMatch: No components match this filter. Try another type or clear the search.
models.noneAvailable: No compatible catalog components are available for this computer yet.
models.catalogInvalid: The component catalog response is invalid.
models.catalogCouldNotLoad: Could not load the component catalog.
engine.configureNeeded: Configure llama.cpp above or set the engine executable path.
engine.modelNeeded: Choose a GGUF model file in the setup form before starting.
engine.waitingReady: The process is running; waiting for the model server to report ready. Large models may take a while to load.
engine.setupNeeded: No engines configured yet. Install an engine from Models or configure one manually in Settings.
engine.waitingModel: Waiting for the model to load
engine.gpuMeasureTitle: Runs a fixed local chat task and samples NVIDIA system utilization/memory while it runs.
engine.gpuConfigureTitle: Configure a CUDA-enabled engine with GPU layers set to auto, then start it.
engine.chatConfigure: Configure llama.cpp above, then start the engine.
engine.chatReady: Model server ready. Chat requests stay on this machine.
engine.chatLoading: The model is loading or the server is not ready yet. Chat will enable when its health check succeeds.
engine.chatCompleteSetup: Choose an installed engine and model in Models → Active runtime profile, apply it, then start the engine from Activity.
engine.chatStart: Start the configured engine to enable chat.
engine.missing: Engine “{id}” is not present in the runtime configuration.
engine.exited: Engine exited before becoming ready. Export diagnostics or inspect the per-user runtime logs.
engine.waiting: Engine started. Waiting for the local model server to become ready…
engine.timeout: Timed out waiting for the model server. Export diagnostics and check the engine executable/model path.
hardware.recommendationsDisclaimer: These are local hardware-based suggestions, not compatibility guarantees. A package being installed or a GPU being detected does not prove that inference uses the GPU.
hardware.cpuBaseline: Start with the CPU baseline and verify each model on this computer.
hardware.gpuUnverified: GPU inference is not automatically confirmed by detecting an adapter or installing a CUDA package. Check engine logs and GPU activity during a real request.
hardware.readFailed: Device information could not be read. The local model runtime remains available.
setup.saved: Saved {id} configuration ({backend} backend) to this user’s local settings. Start the engine below; no model file was uploaded.
diagnostics.created: Diagnostic report created on this device. Review it before sharing; it was not uploaded anywhere.
gpu.running: Running a fixed local inference request and sampling NVIDIA GPU utilization/memory. Other applications may also contribute to these system-wide measurements.
gpu.requestCompleted: Local inference request completed in {seconds} s.
gpu.requestFailed: The local inference request did not complete successfully.
gpu.noDetails: No additional measurement details were provided.
gpu.peakUtilization: GPU {index}: peak utilization {utilization}; memory before {before}, peak {peak}, after {after}{total}.
hardware.gpuUnsupported: GPU enumeration is not supported by this build.
hardware.noGpuReported: No graphics adapter was reported by the operating system.
activity.phase.interrupted: Interrupted when Local AI Runtime was not running
updates.downloadIntro: You are using {current}. The official {version} package will be stored in your Local AI Runtime user-data folder and checked against its advertised size and SHA-256 digest. {guidance}
updates.rolledBack: The previous update attempt was rolled back: {detail}
updates.downloadProgressUnknown: {phase}. Your current installation and user data are unchanged.
updates.confirmApply:
Apply {version} and restart Local AI Runtime?

The current runtime and managed AI engines will stop briefly. User settings, downloaded engines and model files are stored separately and will not be replaced. A backup will be kept for rollback. Do not close this folder or shut down the computer during the update.
models.recoveryHint: The model is already downloaded and verified. Close any app that may be using the model file, confirm the license again, then retry finalization without downloading it again.
engine.gpuEvidenceDisclaimer: This confirms that the engine reported layer offload at startup. It does not measure live GPU utilization during inference.
engine.gpuEvidenceMissing: GPU execution has not been verified from the current engine log.
profile.title: Active runtime profile
profile.description: Installing a package does not activate it. Choose an installed engine backend and an installed model, then apply them together for Chat.
profile.stopEngineFirst: Stop the running engine before changing its active profile.
profile.installEngineFirst: Install a compatible engine package below. Installing it will not activate it automatically.
profile.installModelFirst: Install a model below. Downloading it will not replace the model currently used by Chat.
profile.currentApplied: The selected engine and model are saved for Chat. Start the engine from Activity when you are ready.
profile.chooseAndApply: Choose an installed engine and model, then apply the profile. This does not start the engine.
profile.selectBoth: Select an installed engine package and an installed model.
profile.applied: Runtime profile saved. Start the selected engine from Activity to enable Chat.
chat.engineRequired: The selected chat engine is not ready. Choose and apply a model in Models, then start the engine from Activity. Your message is still here.
engine.profileModelNeeded: Choose and apply an installed model in Models → Active runtime profile before starting this engine.
profile.customApplied: A manually configured engine/model is active. Use Advanced Settings to edit it, or choose an installed catalog profile here.
models.groupModelsDescription: Model weights used by a compatible engine. Installing a model does not activate it.
models.groupEnginesDescription: Execution packages that load models. CPU and CUDA variants are engine backends, not separate models.
models.alreadySelected: This component is selected in the active Chat profile.
models.profileDrafted: Selection added to the profile above. Review it and apply the profile to use it in Chat.
